title: Workspace member dependency graph + sibling linking
description: Members can 'depends = [sibling-member]' (spec s4). Build a separate member graph (distinct from the external-closure topo-sort in 2y1.2): topo-sort members by their inter-member deps, build each member's lib component into .zinc/build, and link dependents against sibling libs + the external closure package-db. Cycle detection across members. This is the multi-member half of nlx.1 (which only covers a single member's inner loop).

title: Self-hosting: zinc builds zinc
description: MVP DEFINITION OF DONE (decided 2026-06-03): 'zinc build' builds zinc itself from a clean checkout, resolving and building zinc's own real deps (typed-process, a TOML parser, optparse-applicative, ...). The single unfakeable acceptance test — exercises resolver, Opt-2 reader, Nix env, build driver, cache, and orchestration against genuine real-world packages at once. The MVP is NOT complete until this passes. Spec s12 rung 3.
notes: Test ladder order (spec s12): rung 1 = zinc-9gh.2 (synthetic) -> rung 2 = zinc-9gh.3 (real leaf via Opt-2) -> rung 3 = THIS (self-hosting). Run after both fixture rungs pass.

title: Diagnostics & error UX
description: The whole thesis is ergonomics ('no solver errors, ever' / 'it just works'). Surface clear, actionable messages for: git ref not found / clone failure; the silent one-ref-per-name conflict resolution (tell the user which ref won and why); system-lib not a valid nixpkgs attr; nix eval failure; ghc compile failure (relay ghc's own error cleanly, not buried in zinc noise). Cross-cutting over resolver/nix/build. Spec thesis + s2 conflict rule.

title: Resolve Latest (*) deps to newest release tag

notes: Edge case: distinguish RELEASE tags (e.g. v2.2.3.0) from arbitrary/non-version tags before semver-sorting, so '*' doesn't latch onto a non-release tag. Frozen in zinc.lock per spec s4.
close_reason: Latest(*) resolution done: Zinc.Version.newestTag (semver, numeric ordering) + Zinc.Git.listTags + Zinc.Fetch wires Latest->newest tag before clone. TDD 68/68 incl. git-fixture e2e; -Wall clean.
